name: Checkout questions
responsibility: Which checkout of a repository this machine reads, choosing a known checkout, and which checkout holds each repository identity for one vault
description: The one rule that every reader of a vault resolves a repository identity by (ADR 0049): checkoutsReadFrom(vault) gives the chosen checkout of every identity, with the vault's own checkout in place of its own identity, and own, that checkout and its identity, so no caller filters for it. It computes eagerly. checkoutOf(repository) answers chosen, unchosen with the known roots, or unknown with the repositories that have a chosen checkout. chooseCheckout(repository, root) answers chosen (changed, replaced), unknown, gone or no-vault, from which the server sends 404 CHECKOUT_UNKNOWN and 422 CHECKOUT_UNUSABLE. Moved from code-binding's vault-checkout.ts with the registry filters of its callers (TASK-653.10).

outgoing.label: whether a known checkout holds a vault the server serves
every checkout, the chosen among them
